description: Pedagogical technique/method names that are NEVER writing skills. If QU extracts any of these as a candidate skill, canonicalizer.is_meta_technique returns True and the downstream code keeps the prior skill unchanged. This prevents the Turn 5 failure mode where 'deepen the think-aloud' caused active.skill to be overwritten with 'think-aloud'.
